changelog: LimitX Studio Navigation: Removed floating quick-action button and integrated tool switcher line-by-line in the sidebar (Chat, Logs/Code, Terminal, Browser, Notes, Workspace)
Top-Right Profile Access: Moved user profile and account status chip to top-right of Chat top bar, replacing the '+' button for instant 1-tap access
Streamlined Sidebar: Moved Themes to Settings & Preferences, removing redundant theme and app grid icons from drawer footer
Completely Removed Mini Apps: Purged Mini App activities, background services, manifest definitions, and developer MCP bridges
Simplified Chat History Menu: Streamlined conversation 3-dot options to strictly Copy ID, Share, and Pin/Unpin with pinned chat prioritization
